from solution import max_length


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: max_length([[0],[1,3],[5,7],[9,11],[13,15,17]]) is (3,[13,15,17])."""
    assert max_length([[0], [1, 3], [5, 7], [9, 11], [13, 15, 17]]) == (3, [13, 15, 17])  # len([13,15,17])=3; max(1,2,2,2,3)=3


def test_issue_single_inner_list():
    """Rule: find the list of lists with maximum length for a single inner list."""
    assert max_length([[4, 5, 6, 7]]) == (4, [4, 5, 6, 7])  # len([4,5,6,7])=4; max(4)=4


def test_issue_max_at_start():
    """Rule: find the list of lists with maximum length when longest is first."""
    assert max_length([[1, 2, 3], [4], [5, 6]]) == (3, [1, 2, 3])  # max(3,1,2)=3; len([1,2,3])=3


def test_issue_max_at_end():
    """Rule: find the list of lists with maximum length when longest is last."""
    assert max_length([[1], [2], [7, 8, 9, 10]]) == (4, [7, 8, 9, 10])  # max(1,1,4)=4; len([7,8,9,10])=4


def test_issue_max_in_middle():
    """Rule: find the list of lists with maximum length when longest is in the middle."""
    assert max_length([[1], [2, 3, 4, 5], [6]]) == (4, [2, 3, 4, 5])  # max(1,4,1)=4; len([2,3,4,5])=4


def test_issue_empty_inners_are_shortest():
    """Rule: find the list of lists with maximum length still works with empty inner lists."""
    assert max_length([[], [], [9, 8]]) == (2, [9, 8])  # max(0,0,2)=2; len([9,8])=2


def test_issue_counts_elements_not_sum():
    """Rule: find by length so [1,2] beats [1000] despite smaller sum."""
    assert max_length([[1000], [1, 2]]) == (2, [1, 2])  # max(1,2)=2; len([1,2])=2; sums 1000 vs 3


def test_issue_counts_elements_not_sum_reversed():
    """Rule: find by length so [1,2] beats [1000] regardless of order."""
    assert max_length([[1, 2], [1000]]) == (2, [1, 2])  # max(2,1)=2; len([1,2])=2; sums 3 vs 1000


def test_issue_tie_reports_correct_length():
    """Rule: find the maximum length is 2 when two lists tie for longest."""
    assert max_length([[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]])[0] == 2  # max(2,2,1)=2


def test_contract_returns_tuple():
    """Contract: example shows result is a tuple pair of length and list."""
    assert isinstance(max_length([[0], [1, 3]]), tuple)  # tuple of 2 items: 1+1=2; max(1,2)=2


def test_contract_does_not_mutate_input():
    """Contract: finding maximum length must not mutate the input list."""
    data = [[0], [1, 3]]  # lengths 1 and 2: max(1,2)=2
    max_length(data)  # call once: 1 call
    assert data == [[0], [1, 3]]  # unchanged 2 inner lists: 1+1=2
